summary: Clackamas County site in the Mount Hood NF where the Forest Service built a cabin around 1929; gone by 1950, and no source describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Cabin gone by 1950 per the register and firelookout.com; no source describes what remains at the site

visit.trail_note: A June 2026 hiker thread says the trail ends at FR 4651 and has dropped out of the Forest Service digital inventory; the sources do not say whether the lookout site itself is open to visitors

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing. The 1929 and 1950 dates come from two listing pages that agree, and the register says only around 1929, so the year is approximate. One web search found no independent source for the cabin. The panorama date disagrees (6-21-34 on the register photo, June 29, 1934 per Kemnow); the story reports both. Elevation: register 5,057 ft, firelookout.com 5040 ft; the record uses the register. The forum thread is hikers' accounts of trail status, used only for access and site context; a Forest Service trail or heritage record would settle the access question before publication.
